title: Phase 1B.1 — Canonical Data Authority & Persistence Universe

methodology.declarationParser: TypeScript compiler API; exported top-level pgTable/pgSchema.table and view declarations in production schema roots.
methodology.activeAccessIndexer: Production TypeScript named imports are linked only to matching exports in directly resolved relative modules, then checked for Drizzle query/insert/update/delete/from/join call patterns. Unresolved imports are reported separately; this does not prove route reachability or runtime execution.
methodology.migrationEvidence: Static CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE POLICY, and RLS enable/force token scan over checked-in SQL and Django migration files. Each file/event retains a source lineage; presence is not proof of application.
methodology.declarationConflictComparison: Duplicate declaration conflict means declared column-name sets differ only. Matching names do not prove compatibility because types, nullability, defaults, keys, and foreign-key semantics are not compared.
methodology.djangoModelIndexer: Recognizes direct models.Model subclasses and transitive subclasses declared in the same models.py file, excludes Meta.abstract models, and does not treat the presence of a models.Field expression alone as proof of model inheritance.
methodology.databaseIdentity: Qualified by source database scope and PostgreSQL schema. financial-service is kept separate from the Union Eyes database scope.

sourceScope.declarationFiles: Production exported declarations in apps/union-eyes/db/schema/**, db/schema*.ts, and financial-service schema modules.

limitations: No live PostgreSQL catalog, deployed schema, migration ledger, or runtime database connection was queried.
A checked-in migration or RLS statement proves only source presence, not that it ran or is currently effective.
Authority is asserted only where checked-in authority registry/model doctrine or canonical schema map explicitly supports it; unregistered objects remain source-ceiling findings.
Access references are source-level candidates, not proof of reachable behavior, successful queries, tenant isolation, or actual writes.
Only direct relative named imports are linked to a declaration; unresolved aliases, re-export barrels, and external imports remain outside object-level access evidence.
Declaration conflicts compare column names only and do not establish semantic incompatibility or compatibility.
Dynamic SQL, generated identifiers, framework indirection, and external provider-side persistence may be incompletely represented.

r1Adjudication.title: Phase 1B.1-R1 — Exact-Five Authority Conflict Adjudication

scope.predicate: persistenceUniverse rows matching productionAccessObserved=true, declarationConflict=true, and canonicalSchemaModule=null
scope.databaseIdentity: Source scope and PostgreSQL schema are recorded separately. No database URL value, server/catalog, deployed schema, or physical database identity was inspected.

methodology.declarationShape: For these exact declarations only, database column names are extracted from the root Drizzle builder call, not from a chained default() call. Other persistence-universe records retain their previous dispositions and extracted fields.
methodology.accessEvidence: Counts are static operation-pattern candidates in directly recorded importing files. They do not establish route reachability, runtime execution, query success, or writes.
methodology.migrationEvidence: References identify checked-in DDL and model/migration source only. No migration was executed and no migration ledger was queried.
methodology.ownerEvidence: A configured Drizzle schema input identifies the source used by that configuration; it does not prove deployed physical schema. Django canonical-owner doctrine applies only where a matching Django model exists.

sourceAuthority.interpretation: The configured input and the output-side/introspection DDL disagree on source shape. Configuration selects the current input for Drizzle generation but does not establish the currently deployed table shape or an explicit ownership registry.

schemaDifferences: The configured src/db/schema.ts declaration adds notification_stage as nullable text defaulting to 'none'; the output-side declaration and 0000 introspection DDL omit it.
The 0000 DDL and output-side declaration include tenant_id; the configured source keeps tenant_id.

migrationEvidence.event: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.arrears
migrationEvidence.note: The file header says it was generated after database introspection and leaves execution commented out; this does not prove application.

sourceAuthority.interpretation: The configured input and the output-side/introspection DDL disagree on organization scope and its dependent constraints. No explicit object-level authority record or verified physical winner was found.

schemaDifferences: The output-side declaration and 0000 DDL use tenant_id; the configured source uses organization_id.

The tenant_id variant references tenant_management.tenants(tenant_id), indexes tenant_id, and scopes unique_rule_code by tenant_id; the organization_id variant references public.organizations(id), indexes organization_id, and scopes uniqueness by organization_id.
The remaining declared columns have matching names and Drizzle types/defaults in the paired declarations.

migrationEvidence.event: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.dues_rules
ALTER TABLE dues_rules ADD tenant_id foreign key

sourceAuthority.interpretation: The configured input and the output-side/introspection DDL disagree on organization scope and dependent constraints. The configured path is source-selection evidence, not physical-schema verification.

schemaDifferences: The output-side declaration and 0000 DDL use tenant_id; the configured source uses organization_id.
The organization-scoped foreign key and status/amount indexes in the configured source differ from the tenant-scoped foreign key and indexes in the output-side shape.
Other declared business columns match by name across these two declarations.

migrationEvidence.event: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.dues_transactions
ALTER TABLE dues_transactions ADD tenant_id foreign key

sourceAuthority.interpretation: The configured source contains additional fields absent from the output-side/introspection DDL. The source config does not prove whether those fields are deployed.

schemaDifferences: The configured source adds days_worked integer default 0 and calculated_amount numeric nullable; both are absent from the output-side declaration and 0000 DDL.
The remaining declared columns, nullability, defaults, and unique member/week constraint match in the paired declarations.

migrationEvidence.event: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stipend_disbursements
ALTER TABLE stipend_disbursements ADD strike_fund_id foreign key

sourceAuthority.interpretation: The repository doctrine and matching concrete Django model establish source-level canonical ownership. They do not prove current deployed physical columns or migration application.

schemaDifferences: The domain declaration adds nullable processor_type, processor_payment_id, and processor_customer_id fields and defines payment_processor values; the directly imported standalone declaration omits those fields.
The Django DuesTransactions model and its initial migration establish a model/table mapping but expose a narrower field set than either Drizzle declaration.

The direct importer uses full-shape .select().from(duesTransactions) candidates and insert/update .returning() candidates; this conflicts with the authority doctrine requiring governed Drizzle read projections and no Drizzle-owned DDL/writes for canonical entities.

migrationEvidence.event: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.dues_transactions
migrationEvidence.note: Repeated source statements in one file are not a chronological or applied-migration signal.

migrationEvidence.event: ALTER TABLE dues_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE dues_transactions FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
Conditional existence check for dues_transactions before organization RLS policy creation

defectRegister.description: The configured source adds notification_stage while the introspection-derived DDL and output-side schema omit it; physical winner is unverified.
tenant_id versus organization_id changes the indexed, unique, and foreign-key scope.
tenant_id versus organization_id changes the foreign-key and index scope.
Configured source-only days_worked and calculated_amount fields are absent from the output-side/introspection shape.

A direct full-shape Drizzle importer uses a noncanonical mirror and performs candidate inserts/updates; the exported domain mirror has three processor fields absent from the directly imported declaration.

principalAuthorityCounts.scope: The five fixed R1 object groups; each group has one exclusive final disposition. Representation counts are reported separately and may overlap.
principalAuthorityCounts.countingNote: The legacy-nonauthoritative and generated/derived table categories are zero as exclusive table-object dispositions in this fixed set. The Union Eyes object is counted as canonical-with-mirror, with its two noncanonical Drizzle declarations counted separately; the four financial-service conflicts remain explicit and are not folded into an authority category.

gate.globalGateRationale: All five fixed records have explicit, registered dispositions and UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY_TABLES is zero within this fixed set. The existing census still contains 260 UNKNOWN_SOURCE_CEILING objects, including seven with indexed production access outside the fixed input, and Phase 1A source-ceiling records remain carried forward. Those objects were not investigated or reclassified by R1.

boundaries: No runtime database, connection string value, database catalog, migration ledger, or deployed schema was inspected.
No migration was executed; no database was written; no application repair was performed.
No unrelated persistence object was reviewed or dispositioned.
No RLS effectiveness, tenant isolation, query reachability, or successful-write claim is made.
Phase 1B.2 and later phases were not started.

reasons: R2 explicitly enumerated all frozen source-ceiling residual records and reached the final static evidence boundary.
207 persistence objects remain with genuinely unresolved authority after the bounded source review.
966 saved schema-like imports remain unresolved; direct-import attribution was not reopened.
56 accepted Phase 1A known database-effect records lack explicit data targets.
247 Phase 1A UNKNOWN_DATA_EFFECT records remain frozen and were not re-adjudicated.
